Indie rock darlings Grand Duchy, five-member Dawes recently settled in Northern California — and they're ready to put in all those hours in their new 1,600-square-foot outpost.

Goldsworthy is good at writing pop songs, as he proved on the hugely popular Grand Duchy, but the best thing here is his raw vocals on the songs he sings, which are either lightning-fast and angelic or rough and heart-wrenching. The Pinwheels and Ribbons Cowl is a simple piece that allows you to knit one pinwheel and one ribbon at a time; you knit some pins straight and then you knit some pins backwards to get ribbing. To create a seamless, taut tubular shape of the cowl without a joining seam, you join a row of caster with a row of ribbon. It's all completely "natural" in every way and a pleasure to knit. You can do three or four rows of ribbon to make a small rabbit, or a long, more streamlined "drape" (the wheel row makes the fabric wide, while the ribbon row keeps it from folding; that's why you want fewer rows of ribbon).
